name: ConcretePourPlanner
tagline: Plan, book, release and test every concrete pour – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete concrete pour app for construction teams: two-week look-ahead with daily capacity, ready-mix bookings, pre-pour hold-point checklist, independent engineer release with hot/cold weather plans, slump and cylinder test frequency on the day, 7/28-day strength results with early warnings and non-conformance follow-up. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Nine-status pour workflow with rule checks
Test frequency, slump tolerance and strength acceptance
Booking requests and CSV export via Power Fx events
controlType: standard (2 controls: ConcretePourPlanner data-set + ConcretePourPlannerPortal field)
